interpretation: Candidate has already materialized 16 remaining old-epoch microbatches on entry; ordinary queue consumption is brief, but input collection still crosses synchronous consumer-owned epoch entry.

The traced input-to-first-forward/backward prefix is about 173 ms shorter on both observed ranks. This one profiled prefix does not explain the separate whole-window TPS result or establish a general speedup.
All observed loader/queue/epoch host spans have zero overlap with local recorded device work; epoch entry remains the dominant candidate input stall.

The first NCCL uint64 token-count reduction includes peer waiting: baseline device durations 83.538/24.028 ms, candidate 110.960/27.355 ms; these are communication/wait kernel spans, not compute costs.
summary.remaining_synchronous_epoch_work: One consumer-owned epoch entry per captured update crosses after16 successful old-epoch deliveries. Candidate consumer epoch spans953.096/886.272ms contain raw loader calls952.390/885.158ms, each with no local device overlap. Internal barrier versus I/O attribution is unavailable.

baseline_epoch_boundary_calls.ordinal_interpretation: Fixed32 successful deliveries contain16 old-epoch reads, ordinal17 exhaustion, then ordinal18 first new-epoch read and15 further reads. The ordinal18 call is the largest call on both ranks.
baseline_epoch_boundary_calls.limits: Ordinary sum includes the ordinal17 exhaustion attempt. Unannotated __iter__, epoch setup, and barrier costs outside __next__ are unobservable separately; no duration is assigned to them.

limits: Only global ranks 0/1 and one update-11 prefix captured. Remaining 29 forward/backward microbatches and optimizer are outside collection.
No stacks or DataLoader worker traces: epoch duration cannot separate barrier, worker restart, I/O, producer scheduling or GIL costs internally.
GPU busy means union of recorded kernel/memcpy/memset intervals on one rank. It includes communication and spin/wait kernels, not solely useful compute; categories overlap and cannot be added.
Kernel duration sums across streams are event costs, not elapsed busy time. NCCL union is an explicit subset, not all EP communication.
No full-update TPS, convergence, GPU memory peak, or complete phase latency is estimated from these traces. Separate unprofiled receipt owns throughput and memory.

sql.device_census: SELECT category,count(*) n,sum(dur)/1e6 sum_ms FROM slice WHERE category IN('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') GROUP BY category
sql.importer_errors: SELECT name,idx,value,severity FROM stats WHERE value!=0 AND severity IN('error','data_loss')
sql.host_spans: SELECT name,count(*) n,sum(dur)/1e6 sum_ms,max(dur)/1e6 max_ms,min(ts) first_ts,max(ts+dur) end_ts FROM slice WHERE category IN('user_annotation','cpu_op') AND (name GLOB 'task.*' OR name GLOB '*DataLoaderIter*') GROUP BY name
sql.first_collective: WITH p AS(SELECT ts a FROM slice WHERE name GLOB 'task.profile_update.11.train_step.rank*') SELECT s.name,(s.ts-p.a)/1e6 rel_ms,s.dur/1e6 dur_ms FROM slice s,p WHERE (s.name='task.token_count.global_reduction' OR (s.category='kernel' AND lower(s.name) GLOB '*nccl*allreduce*')) ORDER BY s.ts LIMIT 3
sql.window_device_unions:
WITH p AS(SELECT ts a,ts+dur z FROM slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name GLOB 'task.profile_update.11.train_step.rank*'), m AS(SELECT min(ts)b FROM slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name GLOB 'task.profile_update.11.microbatch.rank*'),t AS(SELECT ts a,ts+dur b FROM slice WHERE name='task.token_count.global_reduction'),w AS(
SELECT 'input_to_first_fb' name,p.a,m.b FROM p,m UNION ALL SELECT 'input_before_token',p.a,t.a FROM p,t UNION ALL SELECT 'token_reduction',a,b FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'bounded_prefix',a,z FROM p),
c AS(SELECT 'all_device' kind UNION ALL SELECT 'copies' UNION ALL SELECT 'nccl'),
i AS(SELECT w.name,c.kind,w.a wa,w.b wb,max(s.ts,w.a) a,min(s.ts+s.dur,w.b)b FROM w CROSS JOIN c JOIN slice s ON s.ts<w.b AND s.ts+s.dur>w.a AND s.dur>0 AND (c.kind='all_device' AND s.category IN('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') OR c.kind='copies' AND s.category='gpu_memcpy' OR c.kind='nccl' AND s.category='kernel' AND lower(s.name) GLOB '*nccl*')),
o AS(SELECT *,max(b)OVER(PARTITION BY name,kind ORDER BY a,b ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)prev FROM i),
g AS(SELECT *,sum(CASE WHEN prev IS NULL OR a>prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)OVER(PARTITION BY name,kind ORDER BY a,b)grp FROM o),
u AS(SELECT name,kind,grp,min(a)a,max(b)b FROM g GROUP BY name,kind,grp),
r AS(SELECT name,kind,sum(b-a)busy,max(b)last,min(a)first FROM u GROUP BY name,kind),
gaps AS(SELECT name,kind,max(a-lag_end)gap FROM(SELECT name,kind,a,lag(b)OVER(PARTITION BY name,kind ORDER BY a)lag_end FROM u)GROUP BY name,kind)
SELECT w.name,c.kind,(w.b-w.a)/1e6 host_window_ms,coalesce(r.busy,0)/1e6 device_union_ms,((w.b-w.a)-coalesce(r.busy,0))/1e6 no_event_ms,max(coalesce(gaps.gap,0),coalesce(r.first,w.b)-w.a,w.b-coalesce(r.last,w.a))/1e6 largest_gap_ms FROM w CROSS JOIN c LEFT JOIN r ON r.name=w.name AND r.kind=c.kind LEFT JOIN gaps ON gaps.name=w.name AND gaps.kind=c.kind ORDER BY w.name,c.kind
sql.wait_device_overlap: WITH w AS(SELECT id,name,ts a,ts+dur b FROM slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name IN('task.prefetch.queue_pop_wait','task.prefetch.consumer_epoch_entry') OR name GLOB '*DataLoaderIter*'),i AS(SELECT w.id,max(s.ts,w.a)a,min(s.ts+s.dur,w.b)b FROM w JOIN slice s ON s.category IN('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') AND s.dur>0 AND s.ts<w.b AND s.ts+s.dur>w.a),o AS(SELECT *,max(b)OVER(PARTITION BY id ORDER BY a,b ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)prev FROM i),g AS(SELECT *,sum(CASE WHEN prev IS NULL OR a>prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)OVER(PARTITION BY id ORDER BY a,b)grp FROM o),u AS(SELECT id,grp,min(a)a,max(b)b FROM g GROUP BY id,grp),r AS(SELECT id,sum(b-a)busy FROM u GROUP BY id) SELECT w.name,count(*)n,sum(w.b-w.a)/1e6 host_sum_ms,sum(coalesce(r.busy,0))/1e6 all_device_overlap_ms,sum(w.b-w.a-coalesce(r.busy,0))/1e6 no_device_overlap_ms FROM w LEFT JOIN r USING(id)GROUP BY name
sql.flow_coverage: SELECT g.category,count(*)n,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.category IN('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver') THEN g.id END)linked FROM slice g LEFT JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=g.id LEFT JOIN slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE g.category IN('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') GROUP BY g.category
sql.baseline_epoch_boundary_calls: WITH calls AS(SELECT row_number()OVER(ORDER BY ts,id) ordinal,ts,dur FROM slice WHERE name='enumerate(DataLoader)#_MultiProcessingDataLoaderIter.__next__'), totals AS(SELECT count(*) total_calls,sum(dur) total_ns,max(dur) max_ns FROM calls) SELECT c.ordinal,c.dur/1e6 duration_ms,t.total_calls,(t.total_ns-(SELECT dur FROM calls WHERE ordinal=18))/1e6 ordinary_sum_excluding_boundary_read_ms,CASE WHEN c.dur=t.max_ns THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_largest_call FROM calls c CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE c.ordinal IN(17,18) ORDER BY ordinal
